definitions.gloss: hot pot dish; one-pot cooking; nabe cuisine
definitions.explanation: A style of Japanese cooking where ingredients such as vegetables, meat, tofu, and noodles are simmered together in a pot at the table. A communal winter staple in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鍋料理|なべりょうり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧おいしい。
examples.english: Hot pot dishes are delicious in winter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{鍋料理|なべりょうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{囲|かこ}んだ→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧。
examples.english: The whole family gathered around the hot pot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な{鍋料理|なべりょうり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, there are various hot pot dishes unique to each region.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧ (pot) + ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ (cooking, dish). Often shortened to just ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧ in casual speech. Hot pot cooking is strongly associated with the colder months and is a quintessential communal meal in Japan — people sit around the pot and serve themselves.

TYPES:
- ⟦{寄|よ}せ{鍋|なべ}→寄せ鍋：22816_yosenabe⟧: mixed hot pot (various ingredients, light broth)
- ⟦{水炊|みずた}き→水炊き：28920_mizutaki⟧: chicken hot pot (Hakata specialty)
- ⟦すき{焼|や}き→すき焼き：10368_sukiyaki⟧: sukiyaki (sweetened soy broth)
- ⟦しゃぶしゃぶ→しゃぶしゃぶ：10479_shabushabu⟧: shabu-shabu (swishing thin meat slices in broth)
- ⟦キムチ{鍋|なべ}→キムチ鍋：28937_kimuchinabe⟧: kimchi hot pot
- ⟦もつ{鍋|なべ}→もつ鍋：28936_motsunabe⟧: offal hot pot (Fukuoka specialty)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The communal aspect of {鍋料理|なべりょうり} is central — eating from the same pot symbolizes closeness. The term {鍋奉行|なべぶぎょう} (hot pot magistrate) humorously refers to a person who takes charge of the cooking at the table.
